---
title: "Types for code"
description: "The TypeScript types code is written against: the SDK's, and every node's settings and items."
---

<!-- Generated by `make docs-gen` from the code. Do not edit: change the code and regenerate. -->

Code imports everything from `@polythought/sdk`: the SDK's functions and types, and the types of every node's settings and items, named after its type: `polymarket.markets` gives `PolymarketMarketsSettings` and `PolymarketMarketsItem`.

```ts
import { dec } from "@polythought/sdk"
import type { Context, PolymarketMarketsItem } from "@polythought/sdk"
```

Decimals are `DecimalText` and times `TimeText`: text, so they stay exact. `NodeTypes` names every node type's settings and items, whether it is a trigger, and its inputs and outputs, which [workflow code](/docs/guides/workflow-code/) is typed by; a node that passes on what it receives says `"received"`.

## Node types

`nodes.d.ts`

```ts
// Generated by Polythought from its node types: the settings each takes and the items
// it sends on. Do not edit.

import type { Json } from "./sdk";

/** An exact decimal as text, like "0.0200". Do arithmetic with dec(), never as a float. */
export type DecimalText = string;

/** A time as RFC 3339 text, like "2026-10-15T12:00:00Z". */
export type TimeText = string;

/** A duration, like "30s", "5m" or "1h30m". */
export type DurationText = string;

/** A setting's value worked out per item: {{ }} around an expression, like "{{ params.max }}". */
export type Expression = `{{${string}}}`;

/** The settings of Code: aggregate (code.aggregate). */
export interface CodeAggregateSettings {
    /**
     * TypeScript, importing only from @polythought/sdk: dec for exact prices, data requests, and the types of every node's items.
     * @default "import type { Context, Item } from \"@polythought/sdk\"\n\n// Called once with every item; returns one item that sums them up.\nexport function run(items: Item[], ctx: Context): Item {\n  return { count: items.length }\n}\n"
     */
    source?: string;
}

/** The settings of Code: filter (code.filter). */
export interface CodeFilterSettings {
    /**
     * TypeScript, importing only from @polythought/sdk: dec for exact prices, data requests, and the types of every node's items.
     * @default "import type { Context, Item } from \"@polythought/sdk\"\n\n// Called for each item: true keeps it.\nexport function keep(item: Item, ctx: Context): boolean {\n  return item.question !== undefined\n}\n"
     */
    source?: string;
}

/** The settings of Code: route (code.route). */
export interface CodeRouteSettings {
    /**
     * TypeScript, importing only from @polythought/sdk: dec for exact prices, data requests, and the types of every node's items.
     * @default "import { dec } from \"@polythought/sdk\"\nimport type { Context, Item } from \"@polythought/sdk\"\n\n// Called for each item: returns the route it goes down, one of Routes.\nexport function route(item: Item, ctx: Context): string {\n  return dec(String(item.spread ?? 0)).gt(\"0.02\") ? \"wide\" : \"tight\"\n}\n"
     */
    source?: string;
    /**
     * One per line, up to 10. Each route is an output port of the same name.
     * @default ["wide","tight"]
     */
    routes?: string[];
}

/** The settings of Code: transform (code.transform). */
export interface CodeTransformSettings {
    /**
     * TypeScript, importing only from @polythought/sdk: dec for exact prices, data requests, and the types of every node's items.
     * @default "import type { Context, Item } from \"@polythought/sdk\"\n\n// Called once with every item; returns the items to send on.\nexport function run(items: Item[], ctx: Context): Item[] {\n  return items.map((item) =\u003e ({ ...item, seenAt: ctx.execution.startedAt }))\n}\n"
     */
    source?: string;
}

/** The settings of Consensus (logic.consensus). */
export interface LogicConsensusSettings {
    /**
     * How many different traders must agree, this item's among them.
     * @default 2
     */
    needed?: number | Expression;
    /**
     * How far back a trader's agreeing counts, from each item.
     * @default "6h"
     */
    within?: DurationText | Expression;
    /**
     * The fields that must be the same, one per line: the outcome and the side by default, so a buy and a sell do not count together. A field of the items it receives.
     * @default ["tokenId","side"]
     */
    on?: string[];
    /**
     * The field that tells traders apart: one counts once, however often they trade. A field of the items it receives.
     * @default "trader.address"
     */
    who?: string;
}

/** The settings of Only new (logic.dedupe). */
export interface LogicDedupeSettings {
    /**
     * The field that tells items apart, e.g. id, tokenId or txHash. A field of the items it receives.
     * @default "id"
     */
    field?: string;
    /**
     * How long an item counts as seen. A change applies to the items seen after it.
     * @default "24h"
     */
    forget?: DurationText | Expression;
}

/** The settings of Filter (logic.filter). */
export interface LogicFilterSettings {
    /** The item field to test, e.g. spread, or outcomes.0.price for the first outcome's price. A field of the items it receives. */
    field: string;
    /**
     * @default "gt"
     */
    operator?: "gt" | "gte" | "lt" | "lte" | "eq" | "neq" | "is" | "isNot" | "contains" | "notContains" | "exists" | "missing" | Expression;
    /** A number for the comparisons, text for is and contains (any case). Not used by exists and missing. */
    value?: string | number | Expression;
    /** More tests like the first, a row each. Match says how they count together. A table: a row each. */
    tests?: {
        /** The item field to test. */
        field: string;
        /**
         * @default "gt"
         */
        operator?: "gt" | "gte" | "lt" | "lte" | "eq" | "neq" | "is" | "isNot" | "contains" | "notContains" | "exists" | "missing";
        /** A number for the comparisons, text for is and contains (any case). Not used by exists and missing. */
        value?: string | number;
    }[] | Expression;
    /**
     * all: every test passes (AND). any: one or more do (OR). none: not one does (NOT). one: exactly one does (XOR).
     * @default "all"
     */
    match?: "all" | "any" | "none" | "one" | Expression;
}

/** The settings of If (logic.if). */
export interface LogicIfSettings {
    /** The item field to test, e.g. spread, or outcomes.0.price for the first outcome's price. A field of the items it receives. */
    field: string;
    /**
     * @default "gt"
     */
    operator?: "gt" | "gte" | "lt" | "lte" | "eq" | "neq" | "is" | "isNot" | "contains" | "notContains" | "exists" | "missing" | Expression;
    /** A number for the comparisons, text for is and contains (any case). Not used by exists and missing. */
    value?: string | number | Expression;
    /** More tests like the first, a row each. Match says how they count together. A table: a row each. */
    tests?: {
        /** The item field to test. */
        field: string;
        /**
         * @default "gt"
         */
        operator?: "gt" | "gte" | "lt" | "lte" | "eq" | "neq" | "is" | "isNot" | "contains" | "notContains" | "exists" | "missing";
        /** A number for the comparisons, text for is and contains (any case). Not used by exists and missing. */
        value?: string | number;
    }[] | Expression;
    /**
     * all: every test passes (AND). any: one or more do (OR). none: not one does (NOT). one: exactly one does (XOR).
     * @default "all"
     */
    match?: "all" | "any" | "none" | "one" | Expression;
}

/** The settings of Merge (logic.merge). */
export interface LogicMergeSettings {
    /**
     * both: A's items with a match in B (AND). either: A's and B's, once per key (OR). onlyA: A's without a match (NOT). onlyOne: those of A or B with no match in the other (XOR). join: A's with a match, B's item added.
     * @default "both"
     */
    mode?: "both" | "either" | "onlyA" | "onlyOne" | "join" | Expression;
    /** The field that matches A's items with B's, e.g. tokenId. A field of the items it receives on a. */
    field: string;
    /** B's field to match with A's, when it is named otherwise. Empty: the same as A's. A field of the items it receives on b. */
    fieldB?: string;
    /**
     * For join: the field of A's item that holds B's matching item.
     * @default "b"
     */
    joinedAs?: string;
}

/** The settings of Sample (logic.sample). */
export interface LogicSampleSettings {
    /** The share to take, 0 to 100: 30 is about 3 in 10. */
    chance: DecimalText | number | Expression;
    /**
     * The field that tells items apart, e.g. txHash for trades or id: an item with the same value gets the same answer, on a re-run too. A field of the items it receives.
     * @default "txHash"
     */
    field?: string;
}

/** The settings of Switch (logic.switch). */
export interface LogicSwitchSettings {
    /** A row each, tried in order: the port it sends to, and its test. Each port shows on the node. A table: a row each. */
    rules?: {
        /** The output port the items this rule takes leave from. */
        port: string;
        /** The item field to test. */
        field: string;
        /**
         * @default "gt"
         */
        operator?: "gt" | "gte" | "lt" | "lte" | "eq" | "neq" | "is" | "isNot" | "contains" | "notContains" | "exists" | "missing";
        /** A number for the comparisons, text for is and contains (any case). Not used by exists and missing. */
        value?: string | number;
    }[];
}

/** The settings of Throttle (logic.throttle). */
export interface LogicThrottleSettings {
    /** How many items may go on in a period. */
    limit: number | Expression;
    /**
     * The period they count over, back from each item: 24h is any 24 hours.
     * @default "24h"
     */
    per?: DurationText | Expression;
    /** Counts each value of this field on its own, e.g. trader.address for each trader. Empty: all items together. A field of the items it receives. */
    field?: string;
}

/** The settings of Wait (logic.wait). */
export interface LogicWaitSettings {
    /**
     * for: a while. until: the next time the clock shows a time of day.
     * @default "for"
     */
    mode?: "for" | "until" | Expression;
    /**
     * How long, e.g. 30s, 10m or 2h.
     * @default "10m"
     */
    for?: DurationText | Expression;
    /** A time of day in UTC, as HH:MM, e.g. 09:30. With mode until. */
    until?: string;
}

/** The settings of Log (output.log). */
export interface OutputLogSettings {
    /**
     * {{field}} puts in an item's field, e.g. {{question}}.
     * @default "Workflow item"
     */
    message?: string;
}

/** The settings of Webhook (output.webhook). */
export interface OutputWebhookSettings {
    /** From the channel's integration settings in Discord or Slack. */
    url: string;
    /**
     * {{field}} puts in an item's field, e.g. {{question}} or {{spread}}.
     * @default "Update from your Polythought workflow"
     */
    message?: string;
    /**
     * all: one request listing every item. each: one request per item, up to 20 a run.
     * @default "all"
     */
    send?: "all" | "each" | Expression;
    /**
     * message: the text above, for chat apps. json: the items themselves.
     * @default "message"
     */
    format?: "message" | "json" | Expression;
    /** Optional. A header sent with each request, such as Authorization, from your Credentials page. The ID of one of your credentials of type http.header. */
    credential?: string;
}

/** The settings of Balance (polymarket.balance). */
export interface PolymarketBalanceSettings {
    /** The ID of one of your wallets. */
    wallet: string;
}

/** An item Balance (polymarket.balance) sends on. */
export interface PolymarketBalanceItem {
    /** The wallet's ID in Polythought. */
    walletId: string;
    /** The address that signs its orders. */
    signer: string;
    /** Collateral it can spend, in dollars. */
    balance: DecimalText;
    /** When it was read. */
    at: TimeText;
}

/** The settings of Markets (polymarket.markets). */
export interface PolymarketMarketsSettings {
    /**
     * Most markets to return.
     * @default 20
     */
    limit?: number | Expression;
    /**
     * @default false
     */
    closed?: boolean | Expression;
    /** Only these markets. */
    slugs?: string[] | Expression;
    /** Only markets with these tags. */
    tagIds?: string[] | Expression;
}

/** An item Markets (polymarket.markets) sends on. */
export interface PolymarketMarketsItem {
    /** The market's condition ID, 0x… */
    id: string;
    /** Its name in its polymarket.com address. */
    slug: string;
    /** What it settles. */
    question: string;
    /** Whether it trades. */
    status: "open" | "closed" | "resolved" | "archived";
    /** Whether its order books take orders now. */
    acceptingOrders: boolean;
    /** Part of an event whose outcomes exclude each other. */
    negRisk: boolean;
    /** The smallest price step. */
    tickSize: DecimalText;
    /** The smallest order, in shares. */
    minOrderSize: DecimalText;
    /** Dollars traded in the last 24 hours. */
    volume24h: DecimalText;
    /** Dollars on its order books. */
    liquidity: DecimalText;
    /** When it is expected to settle. */
    endsAt: TimeText;
    /** What it can settle as, such as Yes and No. */
    outcomes: {
        /** The outcome's token ID. */
        tokenId: string;
        /** Like Yes or No. */
        label: string;
        /** The last price, a probability from 0 to 1. */
        price: DecimalText;
    }[];
}

/** The settings of Order books (polymarket.orderbook). */
export interface PolymarketOrderbookSettings {
    /**
     * Price levels summed into bidDepth and askDepth.
     * @default 5
     */
    depth?: number | Expression;
}

/** An item Order books (polymarket.orderbook) sends on. */
export interface PolymarketOrderbookItem {
    /** The market's ID, from the item received. */
    marketId: string | null;
    /** The market's question, from the item received. */
    question: string | null;
    /** The outcome's label, like Yes. */
    outcome: string;
    /** The outcome's token ID. */
    tokenId: string;
    /** The highest bid; null when there is none, as are mid and spread. */
    bestBid: DecimalText | null;
    /** The lowest ask. */
    bestAsk: DecimalText | null;
    /** Halfway between the best bid and ask. */
    mid: DecimalText | null;
    /** The best ask less the best bid. */
    spread: DecimalText | null;
    /** Shares bid within the levels counted. */
    bidDepth: DecimalText;
    /** Shares asked within the levels counted. */
    askDepth: DecimalText;
    /** When Polymarket took the book. */
    at: TimeText;
}

/** The settings of Open orders (polymarket.orders). */
export interface PolymarketOrdersSettings {
    /** The ID of one of your wallets. */
    wallet: string;
    /** Only orders in this market (condition ID). */
    market?: string;
}

/** An item Open orders (polymarket.orders) sends on. */
export interface PolymarketOrdersItem {
    /** The wallet's ID in Polythought. */
    walletId: string;
    /** The order's ID. */
    id: string;
    /** The market's condition ID. */
    marketId: string;
    /** The outcome's token ID. */
    tokenId: string;
    /** Like Yes or No. */
    outcome: string;
    /** Whether it buys or sells. */
    side: "buy" | "sell";
    /** Per share. */
    price: DecimalText;
    /** Shares, as placed. */
    size: DecimalText;
    /** Shares matched so far. */
    filled: DecimalText;
    /** Shares still on the book. */
    remaining: DecimalText;
    /** Like live or matched, as Polymarket says. */
    status: string;
    /** GTC, GTD, FOK or FAK. */
    type: string;
    /** When it was placed. */
    createdAt: TimeText;
    /** When it expires; null when it does not. */
    expiresAt: TimeText | null;
}

/** The settings of Positions (polymarket.positions). */
export interface PolymarketPositionsSettings {
    /** The ID of one of your wallets. */
    wallet: string;
    /**
     * Most positions to return.
     * @default 50
     */
    limit?: number | Expression;
}

/** An item Positions (polymarket.positions) sends on. */
export interface PolymarketPositionsItem {
    /** The wallet's ID in Polythought. */
    walletId: string;
    /** The wallet's address. */
    address: string;
    /** The market's condition ID. */
    marketId: string;
    /** The outcome's token ID. */
    tokenId: string;
    /** The market's question. */
    title: string;
    /** Like Yes or No. */
    outcome: string;
    /** Shares held. */
    size: DecimalText;
    /** What a share cost, on average. */
    avgPrice: DecimalText;
    /** What a share is worth now. */
    currentPrice: DecimalText;
    /** size times currentPrice, in dollars. */
    value: DecimalText;
    /** Profit or loss taken, in dollars. */
    realizedPnl: DecimalText;
    /** Profit or loss if sold at currentPrice, in dollars. */
    unrealizedPnl: DecimalText;
    /** The market settled and the shares can be redeemed. */
    redeemable: boolean;
}

/** The settings of Price change (polymarket.priceChange). */
export interface PolymarketPriceChangeSettings {
    /**
     * How long ago, e.g. 1h or 24h.
     * @default "1h"
     */
    window?: DurationText | Expression;
    /**
     * first: the first outcome of each market, usually Yes. all: every outcome.
     * @default "first"
     */
    outcomes?: "first" | "all" | Expression;
}

/** An item Price change (polymarket.priceChange) sends on. */
export interface PolymarketPriceChangeItem {
    /** The market's ID, from the item received. */
    marketId: string | null;
    /** The market's question, from the item received. */
    question: string | null;
    /** The outcome's label, like Yes. */
    outcome: string;
    /** The outcome's token ID. */
    tokenId: string;
    /** The first price in the window. */
    priceThen: DecimalText;
    /** The last price in the window. */
    priceNow: DecimalText;
    /** priceNow less priceThen. */
    change: DecimalText;
    /** The change in percent of priceThen, to 2 places; null when priceThen is 0. */
    changePct: DecimalText | null;
    /** changePct without its sign. */
    absChangePct: DecimalText | null;
    /** When the window began. */
    since: TimeText;
}

/** The settings of Search markets (polymarket.search). */

     * Search closed markets instead of open ones.
     * @default false

}

/** An item Search markets (polymarket.search) sends on. */
export interface PolymarketSearchItem {
    /** The market's condition ID, 0x… */
    id: string;
    /** Its name in its polymarket.com address. */
    slug: string;
    /** What it settles. */
    question: string;
    /** Whether it trades. */
    status: "open" | "closed" | "resolved" | "archived";
    /** Whether its order books take orders now. */
    acceptingOrders: boolean;
    /** Part of an event whose outcomes exclude each other. */
    negRisk: boolean;
    /** The smallest price step. */
    tickSize: DecimalText;
    /** The smallest order, in shares. */
    minOrderSize: DecimalText;
    /** Dollars traded in the last 24 hours. */
    volume24h: DecimalText;

    liquidity: DecimalText;
    /** When it is expected to settle. */
    endsAt: TimeText;
    /** What it can settle as, such as Yes and No. */
    outcomes: {
        /** The outcome's token ID. */
        tokenId: string;
        /** Like Yes or No. */
        label: string;
        /** The last price, a probability from 0 to 1. */
        price: DecimalText;
    }[];
    /** The title of the event it belongs to. */
    event: string;
    /** The event's name in its polymarket.com address. */

/** The settings of Recent trades (polymarket.trades). */
export interface PolymarketTradesSettings {
    /**
     * How far back, e.g. 15m or 1h.
     * @default "1h"
     */
    since?: DurationText | Expression;
    /**
     * Most trades per market, up to 500.
     * @default 50
     */
    limit?: number | Expression;
}

/** An item Recent trades (polymarket.trades) sends on. */
export interface PolymarketTradesItem {
    /** The market's condition ID. */
    marketId: string;
    /** The market's question, from the item received. */
    question: string | null;
    /** The outcome's label, like Yes. */
    outcome: string;
    /** The outcome's token ID. */
    tokenId: string;
    /** Whether the taker bought or sold. */
    side: "buy" | "sell";
    /** Per share. */
    price: DecimalText;
    /** In shares. */
    size: DecimalText;
    /** price times size, in dollars. */
    value: DecimalText;
    /** The trader's wallet address. */
    wallet: string;
    /** When it happened. */
    at: TimeText;
    /** The transaction that settled it. */

}

/** The settings of Telegram question (telegram.ask). */
export interface TelegramAskSettings {
    /**
     * {{field}} puts in an item's field, e.g. {{question}}. Several items make a line each; one answer goes for all of them.
     * @default "Go ahead?"
     */
    message?: string;
    /**
     * text: sent as written. html: Telegram's tags work, such as <b>, <i>, <code> and <a href="…">; item fields are escaped.
     * @default "text"
     */
    format?: "text" | "html" | Expression;
    /**
     * One per line, up to 10, at most 40 characters each. Each button is an output port of the same name.
     * @default ["Yes","No"]
     */
    buttons?: string[];
    /**
     * How long to wait for a press before the items go through timeout, e.g. 30m or 24h. At most the instance's longest wait, 7 days unless an admin changed it.
     * @default "1h"
     */
    timeout?: DurationText | Expression;
}

/** The settings of Telegram message (telegram.send). */
export interface TelegramSendSettings {
    /**
     * {{field}} puts in an item's field, e.g. {{question}} or {{spread}}.
     * @default "Update from your Polythought workflow"
     */
    message?: string;
    /**
     * text: sent as written. html: Telegram's tags work, such as <b>, <i>, <code> and <a href="…">; item fields are escaped.
     * @default "text"
     */
    format?: "text" | "html" | Expression;
    /**
     * all: one message listing every item. each: one message per item, up to 20 a run.
     * @default "all"
     */
    send?: "all" | "each" | Expression;
    /**
     * Deliver without a sound.
     * @default false
     */
    silent?: boolean | Expression;
}

/** The settings of Cancel orders (trading.cancelOrders). */
export interface TradingCancelOrdersSettings {
    /**
     * order: the item's order, as Place order or Order activity put it on the item. all: every order of the workflow resting on the book. market or outcome: those in it.
     * @default "order"
     */
    which?: "order" | "all" | "market" | "outcome" | Expression;
    /** For market: its condition ID. */
    marketId?: string;
    /** For outcome: its token ID. */
    tokenId?: string;
}

/** The settings of Copy sizing (trading.copySize). */
export interface TradingCopySizeSettings {
    /**
     * fixed: Dollars a buy. multiple: Multiple times what they spent. proportional: the share of their portfolio they spent, of what the workflow is worth: its cash (the paper account's, or live its wallet's pUSD) and what its holdings cost.
     * @default "fixed"
     */
    sizing?: "fixed" | "multiple" | "proportional" | Expression;
    /**
     * A fixed buy's dollars.
     * @default "10"
     */
    dollars?: DecimalText | number | Expression;
    /**
     * For multiple: 0.1 buys a tenth of what they spent.
     * @default "0.1"
     */
    multiple?: DecimalText | number | Expression;
    /**
     * How much worse than their price per share a copy may pay, or take when it sells.
     * @default "0.02"
     */
    slippage?: DecimalText | number | Expression;
}

/** The settings of Place order (trading.placeOrder). */
export interface TradingPlaceOrderSettings {
    /**
     * copy: the order Copy sizing worked out. settings: the order these settings make.
     * @default "copy"
     */
    from?: "copy" | "settings" | Expression;
    /** For settings: the outcome's token ID. */
    tokenId?: string;
    /** For settings. */
    side?: "buy" | "sell" | Expression;
    /** For settings: the limit, the most a buy pays per share or the least a sell takes. */
    price?: DecimalText | number | Expression;
    /** For settings: how many to buy or sell. */
    shares?: DecimalText | number | Expression;
    /** For settings: a buy of so many dollars instead of shares. */
    dollars?: DecimalText | number | Expression;
    /**
     * For settings. FAK: what the book has within the price, the rest cancelled. FOK: all of it, or nothing. GTC: what the book has, the rest resting at the price until filled or cancelled. GTD: the same, until Expires after.
     * @default "FAK"
     */
    type?: "FAK" | "FOK" | "GTC" | "GTD" | Expression;
    /**
     * For copy: copy, as Copy sizing worked it out, a FAK. GTC or GTD: resting at the copy's price instead, what fills at once included.
     * @default "copy"
     */
    copyAs?: "copy" | "GTC" | "GTD" | Expression;
    /**
     * For GTD: how long it rests, 3 minutes at the least; then what is left is cancelled.
     * @default "1h"
     */
    expiresAfter?: DurationText | Expression;
    /**
     * For GTC and GTD: refused rather than matched at once, so it only ever rests on the book.
     * @default false
     */
    postOnly?: boolean | Expression;
}

/** The settings of Place orders (trading.placeOrders). */
export interface TradingPlaceOrdersSettings {
    /** A row per order; or the whole table an expression giving a list of them, like {{ basket }}, each with tokenId, side, price, shares or dollars, and type. A table: a row each. */
    orders: {
        /** The outcome's token ID. */
        tokenId: string;
        side: "buy" | "sell";
        /** The limit: the most a buy pays per share, the least a sell takes. */
        price: DecimalText | number;
        /** How many to buy or sell. */
        shares?: DecimalText | number;
        /** A buy of so many dollars instead of shares. */
        dollars?: DecimalText | number;
        /**
         * @default "FAK"
         */
        type?: "FAK" | "FOK" | "GTC" | "GTD";
        /** Its market's condition ID; looked up when empty. */
        marketId?: string;
    }[] | Expression;
    /**
     * For GTD rows: how long they rest, 3 minutes at the least; then what is left is cancelled.
     * @default "1h"
     */
    expiresAfter?: DurationText | Expression;
    /**
     * For GTC and GTD rows: refused rather than matched at once, so they only ever rest.
     * @default false
     */
    postOnly?: boolean | Expression;
}

/** The settings of Risk guard (trading.riskGuard). */
export interface TradingRiskGuardSettings {
    /** The most one copy spends. */
    maxPerCopy?: DecimalText | number | Expression;
    /** The most the workflow holds in one market, at cost, all traders' copies together, with what its resting buys there hold. */
    maxPerMarket?: DecimalText | number | Expression;
    /** The most the workflow's buys spend in 24 hours, with what its resting buys hold. */
    maxPerDay?: DecimalText | number | Expression;
    /** Buys at a lower price are blocked. */
    minPrice?: DecimalText | number | Expression;
    /** Buys at a higher price are blocked. */
    maxPrice?: DecimalText | number | Expression;
    /** Buys only in markets with one of these tags, like Politics; empty: any. */
    categories?: string[] | Expression;
    /** No buys in markets with any of these tags, like Sports. */
    notCategories?: string[] | Expression;
}

/** The settings of Keep fields (transform.pick). */
export interface TransformPickSettings {
    /** One per line, e.g. question and spread. Paths like outcomes.0.price work too. A field of the items it receives. */
    fields: string[];
}

/** The settings of Split out (transform.splitOut). */
export interface TransformSplitOutSettings {
    /** The list to split, e.g. outcomes. An entry's own fields go at the top, beside the item's others. A field of the items it receives. */
    field: string;
}

/** The settings of Top items (transform.top). */
export interface TransformTopSettings {
    /** A numeric field, e.g. liquidity, volume24h or absChangePct. A field of the items it receives. */
    field: string;
    /**
     * @default "desc"
     */
    order?: "desc" | "asc" | Expression;
    /**
     * How many items to keep.
     * @default 10
     */
    limit?: number | Expression;
}

/** The settings of Manual (trigger.manual). */
export type TriggerManualSettings = Record<string, never>;

/** An item Manual (trigger.manual) sends on. */
export type TriggerManualItem = Record<string, never>;

/** The settings of Market activity (trigger.market). */
export interface TriggerMarketSettings {
    /** Outcome token IDs to watch. Outcome token IDs. */
    tokens: string[];
    /**
     * @default ["trade"]
     */
    on?: ("trade" | "book" | "quote" | "tick" | "resolution")[];
    /**
     * Updates in one window start one execution.
     * @default "5s"
     */
    batch?: DurationText;
}

/** An item Market activity (trigger.market) sends on. */
export interface TriggerMarketItem {
    /** What happened. */
    kind: "trade" | "book" | "quote" | "tick" | "resolution";
    /** The market's condition ID. */
    marketId: string;
    /** The outcome's token ID; not for resolutions. */
    tokenId?: string;
    /** When it happened. */
    at: TimeText;
    /** Trades: whether the taker bought or sold. Book changes: the side that changed. */
    side?: "buy" | "sell";
    /** Trades: per share. Book changes: the level's price. */
    price?: DecimalText;
    /** Trades: shares. Book changes: the level's new size. */
    size?: DecimalText;
    /** Trades: the transaction that settled it. */
    txHash?: string;
    /** Books and quotes: the highest bid; null on an empty side. */
    bestBid?: DecimalText | null;
    /** Books and quotes: the lowest ask. */
    bestAsk?: DecimalText | null;
    /** Book snapshots: halfway between the best bid and ask. */
    mid?: DecimalText | null;
    /** Book snapshots: the best ask less the best bid. */
    spread?: DecimalText | null;
    /** Tick size changes: the new smallest price step. */
    tickSize?: DecimalText;
    /** Resolutions: the token that won. */
    winningTokenId?: string;
    /** Resolutions: the outcome that won, like Yes. */
    winningOutcome?: string;
}

/** The settings of Order activity (trigger.orderActivity). */
export interface TriggerOrderActivitySettings {
    /**
     * filled: a resting order filled, in part or wholly. canceled: what was left of it was cancelled, by Cancel orders, its Trading view, Polymarket or its market resolving. expired: a GTD's time came. failed: a live trade failed on chain and the books undid it.
     * @default ["filled","canceled","expired","failed"]
     */
    events?: ("filled" | "canceled" | "expired" | "failed")[];
}

/** An item Order activity (trigger.orderActivity) sends on. */
export interface TriggerOrderActivityItem {
    /** What happened: filled, canceled, expired or failed. */
    event: "filled" | "canceled" | "expired" | "failed";
    /** paper or live. */
    mode: "paper" | "live";
    /** The order, as it is now. */
    order: {
        /** Its ID in the workflow's orders: Cancel orders cancels it by it. */
        id: string;
        /** open, filled, partial, canceled, expired or failed. */
        status: string;
        /** buy or sell. */
        side: "buy" | "sell";
        /** FAK, FOK, GTC or GTD. */
        type: string;
        /** The outcome's token ID. */
        tokenId: string;
        /** The market's condition ID. */
        marketId: string | null;
        /** Its limit. */
        price: DecimalText;
        /** Shares asked for; zero for a buy of dollars. */
        shares: DecimalText;
        /** Shares it filled so far. */
        filled: DecimalText;
        /** Dollars they came to. */
        dollars: DecimalText;
        /** Fees paid, in dollars. */
        fees: DecimalText;
        /** How it stands, or why it ended. */
        reason: string | null;
        /** The wallet whose trade it copied, if any. */
        trader: string | null;
    };
    /** For filled and failed: the fills it is about. */
    fills: {
        /** Its price per share. */
        price: DecimalText;
        /** Its shares. */
        shares: DecimalText;
        /** Shares times price. */
        dollars: DecimalText;
        /** Its fee, in dollars; a maker pays none. */
        fee: DecimalText;
    }[];
    /** When it was seen. */
    at: TimeText;
}

/** The settings of Schedule (trigger.schedule). */
export interface TriggerScheduleSettings {
    /** A duration like 30s or 5m. */
    interval: DurationText;
    /**
     * Also fire as soon as the workflow is activated.
     * @default true
     */
    runOnStart?: boolean;
}

/** An item Schedule (trigger.schedule) sends on. */
export interface TriggerScheduleItem {
    /** When the schedule fired. */
    firedAt: TimeText;
}

/** The settings of Telegram message (trigger.telegram). */
export interface TriggerTelegramSettings {
    /** Only messages that start with this, in any letter case, e.g. /report. Empty: every message. The bot keeps /start, /menu and the names of its menu's sections for itself. */
    startsWith?: string;
}

/** An item Telegram message (trigger.telegram) sends on. */
export interface TriggerTelegramItem {
    /** The whole message. */
    text: string;
    /** What follows Starts with, trimmed; the whole message without it. */
    rest: string;
    /** Your Telegram username, without the @. */
    username: string;
    /** Your first name on Telegram. */
    firstName: string;
    /** When the bot got it. */
    receivedAt: TimeText;
}

/** The settings of Wallet activity (trigger.walletActivity). */
export interface TriggerWalletActivitySettings {
    /** A row a trader: their trades start the workflow while their row is on. A table: a row each. */
    traders: {
        /** Who they are to you. */
        label: string;
        /** Their Polymarket wallet: the address in their profile's link. A Polygon address: 0x and 40 hex digits. */
        address: string;
        /**
         * Off, their trades are not followed.
         * @default true
         */
        on?: boolean;
        /** Scales what Copy sizing works out for their trades; empty is 1. */
        scale?: DecimalText | number;
        /** The most dollars a copy of one of their trades may spend; empty leaves it to the Risk guard. */
        maxDollars?: DecimalText | number;
        /** The share of their buys Copy sizing copies, each the same way every time: 30 is about 3 in 10. Empty copies them all. */
        take?: DecimalText | number;
    }[];
    /**
     * @default ["buy","sell"]
     */
    sides?: ("buy" | "sell")[];
    /**
     * Trades worth fewer dollars are skipped.
     * @default "0"
     */
    least?: DecimalText | number;
    /**
     * After the server restarts or the trade stream drops, trades missed meanwhile still start the workflow if they are younger than this, up to an hour; older ones are skipped.
     * @default "2m"
     */
    catchUp?: DurationText;
}

/** An item Wallet activity (trigger.walletActivity) sends on. */
export interface TriggerWalletActivityItem {
    /** Whose trade it is: their row of Traders. */
    trader: {
        /** Their label. */
        label: string;
        /** Their wallet. */
        address: string;
        /** Their name on Polymarket. */
        name: string | null;
        /** Size ×: what Copy sizing works out is scaled by it. */
        scale: DecimalText | null;
        /** Max $: the most a copy may spend. */
        maxDollars: DecimalText | null;
        /** Take %: the share of their buys copied. */
        take: DecimalText | null;
    };
    /** Whether they bought or sold. */
    side: "buy" | "sell";
    /** taker: their order met the book; maker: a resting order of theirs filled. Null when the source did not say. */
    role: "taker" | "maker" | null;
    /** The outcome's token ID. */
    tokenId: string;
    /** The market's condition ID. */
    marketId: string | null;
    /** The market's question. */
    question: string | null;
    /** The outcome, like Yes. */
    outcome: string | null;
    /** The market's slug. */
    slug: string | null;
    /** Its event's slug. */
    eventSlug: string | null;
    /** Shares traded, all its fills together. */
    shares: DecimalText;
    /** The average price per share. */
    price: DecimalText;
    /** Dollars traded: shares times their prices. */
    dollars: DecimalText;
    /** How many fills it took. */
    fills: number;
    /** The transaction. */
    txHash: string;
    /** When it happened. */
    at: TimeText;
}

/**
 * Every node type by name: its settings, and the items it sends on. "received" means
 * the items it was given, as they are; "picked", those with only the fields its
 * settings name; "split", an item for each entry of the list its settings name, with
 * the other fields; "merged", those of its two inputs, as its settings combine them.
 * Then whether it starts workflows, and the names of its input and
 * output ports; a type whose ports a setting makes takes any name beside its own.
 */
export interface NodeTypes {
    "code.aggregate": {
        settings: CodeAggregateSettings;
        items: Json;
        trigger: false;
        inputs: "main";
        outputs: "main";
    };
    "code.filter": {
        settings: CodeFilterSettings;
        items: "received";
        trigger: false;
        inputs: "main";
        outputs: "main";
    };
    "code.route": {
        settings: CodeRouteSettings;
        items: "received";
        trigger: false;
        inputs: "main";
        outputs: (string & {});
    };
    "code.transform": {

        items: Json;
        trigger: false;
        inputs: "main";
        outputs: "main";
    };
    "logic.consensus": {
        settings: LogicConsensusSettings;
        items: "received";
        trigger: false;
        inputs: "main";
        outputs: "main" | "alone";
    };
    "logic.dedupe": {
        settings: LogicDedupeSettings;
        items: "received";
        trigger: false;
        inputs: "main";
        outputs: "main";
    };
    "logic.filter": {
        settings: LogicFilterSettings;
        items: "received";
        trigger: false;
        inputs: "main";
        outputs: "main";
    };
    "logic.if": {
        settings: LogicIfSettings;
        items: "received";
        trigger: false;
        inputs: "main";
        outputs: "true" | "false";
    };
    "logic.merge": {
        settings: LogicMergeSettings;
        items: "merged";
        trigger: false;
        inputs: "a" | "b";
        outputs: "main";
    };
    "logic.sample": {
        settings: LogicSampleSettings;
        items: "received";
        trigger: false;
        inputs: "main";
        outputs: "main" | "rest";
    };
    "logic.switch": {
        settings: LogicSwitchSettings;
        items: "received";
        trigger: false;
        inputs: "main";
        outputs: "other" | (string & {});
    };
    "logic.throttle": {
        settings: LogicThrottleSettings;
        items: "received";
        trigger: false;
        inputs: "main";
        outputs: "main" | "limited";
    };
    "logic.wait": {
        settings: LogicWaitSettings;
        items: "received";
        trigger: false;
        inputs: "main";
        outputs: "main";
    };
    "output.log": {
        settings: OutputLogSettings;
        items: "received";
        trigger: false;
        inputs: "main";
        outputs: "main";
    };
    "output.webhook": {
        settings: OutputWebhookSettings;
        items: "received";
        trigger: false;

        outputs: "main";
    };
    "polymarket.balance": {
        settings: PolymarketBalanceSettings;

        inputs: "main";
        outputs: "main";
    };
    "polymarket.markets": {
        settings: PolymarketMarketsSettings;
        items: PolymarketMarketsItem;
        trigger: false;
        inputs: "main";
        outputs: "main";
    };
    "polymarket.orderbook": {
        settings: PolymarketOrderbookSettings;
        items: PolymarketOrderbookItem;
        trigger: false;
        inputs: "main";
        outputs: "main";
    };
    "polymarket.orders": {
        settings: PolymarketOrdersSettings;
        items: PolymarketOrdersItem;
        trigger: false;
        inputs: "main";
        outputs: "main";
    };
    "polymarket.positions": {
        settings: PolymarketPositionsSettings;

        trigger: false;
        inputs: "main";
        outputs: "main";

    "polymarket.priceChange": {
        settings: PolymarketPriceChangeSettings;

        trigger: false;
        inputs: "main";

    "polymarket.search": {

    };
    "polymarket.trades": {
        settings: PolymarketTradesSettings;
        items: PolymarketTradesItem;
        trigger: false;
        inputs: "main";
        outputs: "main";
    };
    "telegram.ask": {
        settings: TelegramAskSettings;

    "telegram.send": {
```

## The SDK

`sdk.d.ts`

```ts
/**
 * The Polythought SDK: what your code imports from "@polythought/sdk".
 *
 * Items are plain JSON. Decimals in them, like prices and sizes, are text such as
 * "0.0200", so they stay exact: do arithmetic on them with {@link dec}. Times are RFC 3339
 * text. Data comes from Polythought through the requests below, which are read-only,
 * reach only your own wallets, and count against the run's limit of data requests.
 *
 * @packageDocumentation
 */
/** A JSON value: what items are made of. */
export type Json = string | number | boolean | null | Json[] | {
    [field: string]: Json;
};
/** One record flowing between nodes. */
export type Item = {
    [field: string]: Json;
};
/**
 * An exact decimal, for prices, sizes and money, which must not become floats. Make one
 * with {@link dec}. It turns into text in JSON, so you can return it in an item.
 */
export interface Decimal {
    plus(n: DecimalLike): Decimal;
    minus(n: DecimalLike): Decimal;
    times(n: DecimalLike): Decimal;
    /** Keeps 20 decimal places, rounding half up. */
    div(n: DecimalLike): Decimal;
    mod(n: DecimalLike): Decimal;
    /** To a whole power; negative powers divide, keeping 20 decimal places. */
    pow(exponent: number): Decimal;
    abs(): Decimal;
    neg(): Decimal;
    /** To dp decimal places, 0 unless given; half up unless another mode is given. */
    round(dp?: number, mode?: RoundingMode): Decimal;
    /** -1 when less than n, 0 when equal, 1 when greater. */
    cmp(n: DecimalLike): -1 | 0 | 1;
    eq(n: DecimalLike): boolean;
    gt(n: DecimalLike): boolean;
    gte(n: DecimalLike): boolean;
    lt(n: DecimalLike): boolean;
    lte(n: DecimalLike): boolean;
    /** As text with dp decimal places, rounding half up; all of them unless dp is given. */
    toFixed(dp?: number): string;
    /** As text, never in exponent form. */
    toString(): string;
    /** As a float: for display and Math only, never for prices you act on. */
    toNumber(): number;
    /** As text, like toString: what JSON holds. */
    toJSON(): string;
}
/** What {@link dec} takes: text like "0.0200", a number, or a decimal. */
export type DecimalLike = Decimal | string | number;
/** 0 towards zero, 1 half up, 2 half to even, 3 away from zero. */
export type RoundingMode = 0 | 1 | 2 | 3;
/**
 * Makes an exact decimal of n. Text that is not a number throws.
 *
 * @example
 * const spread = dec(item.bestAsk).minus(item.bestBid)
 * if (spread.lt("0.02")) return { ...item, spread }
 */
export declare function dec(n: DecimalLike): Decimal;
/** The run your code is part of, passed to your function after its own arguments. */
export interface Context<Params extends Record<string, Json> = Record<string, Json>> {
    /** The node's settings, as you configured them. */
    readonly params: Readonly<Params>;
    readonly execution: Execution;
    /** Writes a line to the run's log, as console.log does. */
    log(...values: unknown[]): void;
}
export interface Execution {
    readonly id: string;
    readonly workflowId: string;
    /** When it started, as RFC 3339 text. */
    readonly startedAt: string;
}
/** A market, with the fields of the Markets node's items. Decimals are text. */
export interface Market {
    /** The condition ID, 0x… */
    id: string;
    slug: string;
    question: string;
    /** open, closed, resolved or archived. */
    status: string;
    acceptingOrders: boolean;
    negRisk: boolean;
    tickSize: string;
    minOrderSize: string;
    volume24h: string;
    liquidity: string;
    /** RFC 3339 text. */
    endsAt: string;
    outcomes: Outcome[];
}
export interface Outcome {
    tokenId: string;
    label: string;
    price: string;
}
/** A market search found, with its event. */
export interface FoundMarket extends Market {
    event: string;
    eventSlug: string;
}
/** One outcome token's order book. Prices and sizes are text. */
export interface OrderBook {
    tokenId: string;
    /** Null when that side is empty, as are mid and spread. */
    bestBid: string | null;
    bestAsk: string | null;
    mid: string | null;
    spread: string | null;
    /** The sizes on each side, summed over the levels returned. */
    bidDepth: string;
    askDepth: string;
    /** Best first. */
    bids: Level[];
    asks: Level[];
    /** When Polymarket took it, as RFC 3339 text. */
    at: string;
}
export interface Level {
    price: string;
    size: string;
}
/** An open position in one of your wallets, with the fields of the Positions node's items. */
export interface Position {
    walletId: string;
    address: string;
    marketId: string;
    tokenId: string;
    title: string;
    outcome: string;
    size: string;
    avgPrice: string;
    currentPrice: string;
    value: string;
    realizedPnl: string;
    unrealizedPnl: string;
    redeemable: boolean;
}
/** Markets on Polymarket. */
export declare const markets: {
    /**
     * Finds open markets by words in their event's title, like the Search markets node.
     * At most 50; 10 unless limit says otherwise. closed searches closed markets instead.
     */
    search(query: string, options?: {
        limit?: number;
        closed?: boolean;
    }): Promise<FoundMarket[]>;
    /** A market by its condition ID (0x…) or its slug; null when there is none. */
    get(idOrSlug: string): Promise<Market | null>;
};
/** Order books on Polymarket. */
export declare const orderBooks: {
    /**
     * The books of up to 50 outcome tokens, in the order asked, null for a token that has
     * none. Up to depth levels on each side: 10 unless given, at most 50.
     */
    get(tokenIds: string[], options?: {
        depth?: number;
    }): Promise<(OrderBook | null)[]>;
};
/** Your positions. */
export declare const positions: {
    /** The open positions of one of your wallets, by its ID: at most 500; 50 unless limit says otherwise. */
    list(walletId: string, options?: {
        limit?: number;
    }): Promise<Position[]>;
};
```
